parsed.answer: For Cobalt’s next outage, Ivo should use REPLAY-1-632: it was tested on August 8 and restored the missing updates. The delivery-mode change was prompted by the GATE-1-519 outages; on August 15, Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286.

citations.quote: The team tested REPLAY-1-632, which restored the missing updates.
For the next outage, use the recovery procedure validated on August 8.
Ivo approved switching Cobalt from BATCH-1-741 to STREAM-1-286. This supersedes the August 1 delivery decision. The cause was the GATE-1-519 outages recorded on August 8
